citations.quote:
[name="莱昂图索"]咳咳、咳咳……
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#8$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#1$1",focus=2)]
[name="莱昂图索"]人……都撤退了？
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#1$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#1$1",focus=1)]
[name="德克萨斯"]没事吧。
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#1$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#2$1",focus=2)]
[characteraction(name="right", type="shake", power=10, times=100, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[name="莱昂图索"]没……嘶……
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#5$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#2$1",focus=1)]
[name="德克萨斯"]你受伤了，别动，这样很容易失血。
[name="德克萨斯"]我已经联络了支援，他们很快就到。
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#5$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#6$1",focus=2)]
[name="莱昂图索"]我没事，可怎么会……
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#1$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#6$1",focus=1)]
[name="德克萨斯"]今天这场宴会有多少人知道？
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#1$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#5$1",focus=2)]
[name="莱昂图索"]你的意思是……
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#1$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#1$1",focus=2)]
[name="莱昂图索"]确实，这种有组织有规模的袭击，不可能没有预谋。
[name="莱昂图索"]但我现在的身份是公开的，想要知道我的行踪没有那么困难……
[name="莱昂图索"]总之，还好你来得够及时。
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#2$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#1$1",focus=1)]
[name="德克萨斯"]卡拉奇死了。
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Character(name="avg_1028_texas2_1#2$1",name2="avg_427_vigil_1#5$1",focus=2)]
[name="莱昂图索"]你说什么？！
[Character(name="avg_npc_695_1#3$1")]
[name="瓦拉赫"]*哥伦比亚俚语*，什么？！
[Character(name="avg_npc_689_1#3$1")]
[name="卢比奥"]卡拉奇……死了？

contributions.description: 众人在获救后同听德克萨斯告知卡拉奇死亡，分别回应。
